eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 3:04 AM on AUG 22, 2024 Effective until 1:04 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Phoenix Police Department is looking for 51-year-old Mohamed Abdi. Mohamed is a black male, 5 feet 11 inches tall, 160 pounds, bald, with brown eyes, and wears glasses. Mohamed was last seen wearing a long sleeve blue shirt, and blue pants. He was last seen on August 20th, 2024, at 8:30p.m. on foot in the area of North 27th Street and East Thomas Road. Mohamed suffers from multiple medical conditions which may cause him to appear confused. If you have seen Mohamed, please contact the Phoenix Police Department or call 9 1 1. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
